verdict.rationale: The evidence shows sign-in only through a device code approved at omnirush.ai/console, plus the option to add your own OpenAI, Anthropic or other provider API keys. Nothing documents enterprise SSO (SAML/OIDC) or authentication through a cloud platform such as Bedrock or Vertex. Bring-your-own provider keys is an adjacent feature, not enterprise identity or cloud-platform authentication, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can authenticate through an enterprise identity or cloud platform for compliance and scalability
